info.title: A little clarity before you swap
info.step1: 1. Choose the token you want to pay with and enter an amount from your demo balance.
info.step2: 2. Choose what to receive. The preview includes a {{fee}} simulated service fee, rounded down to 8 decimal places.
info.step3: 3. Review and confirm within {{seconds}} seconds. Your demo balances update after a successful swap.
info.prices: Prices are local data, not live market rates. The supplied Switcheo feed is dated {{date}}. Missing tokens use deterministic fictional sample prices, labeled in the token picker. Refreshing the page resets the demo wallet.
info.network: All API requests are intercepted locally by Mock Service Worker. No wallet is connected and no blockchain transaction is sent.
